items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 159:1
items.html: (To the question) Yaakov and Rachel do not come out from the Nukva except at the time that she has Mochin that come out in the place of the AVI of the AB of the Mazal, when the backs of AVI are also corrected through these Mochin — namely Yaakov and Rachel: Yaakov is corrected from the Mochin of Aba, and Rachel from the Mochin of Ima. And it is known that in the return of the Nukva face to face with ZA, she no longer has these Mochin of AVI, but she receives the Mochin from ZA, out of the coupling made at the head of ZA upon the Malchut of Ima. Then the backs of AVI, which are Yaakov and Rachel, cannot receive any correction from her, for they are corrected only in the Mochin that come out in AVI, as explained. (Item 190. And p. 803, Sub Header “And this”. And Item 208. And in Pnimi there, Sub Header “Yaakov”).
